history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration expedite its review and revision of the administrative instruction on programme support accounts to ensure effective utilization of the programme support cost funds.
history.administration_response: Consultations were undertaken with key stakeholders in the United Nations Office at Geneva, the United Nations Office at Vienna, the United Nations Office at Nairobi, the United Nations Environment Programme, the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) and the Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific. The Administration’s second internal draft of the guidelines on the management of programme support costs has undergone initial internal review, and the document is being revised and updated based on the suggestions and feedback. As the next step, the updated draft will be shared with the wider relevant stakeholders for consultations.
history.board_assessment: Given that work is underway to review and revise the administrative instruction on programme support accounts incorporating guidance on the level of programme support costs reserves, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration expedite its review and revision of the administrative instruction on programme support accounts to ensure effective utilization of the programme support cost funds.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented. The recommendation was for the Administration to review and revise the administrative instruction on programme support costs. The Administration provided evidence that new guidance on programme support costs had been issued and that the criteria for the closure of this recommendation had been met. Therefore, the Administration respectfully requests the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: As clarified by the Administration during the field audit, administrative instructions promulgate high-level key principles on the basis of relevant resolutions of the General Assembly, are issued by the Under-Secretary-General for Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance, and constitute part of the formal regulatory framework of the Organization. Guidelines cover operational processes and procedures, enable the appropriate interpretation and implementation of administrative instructions and are usually issued by heads of entity as internal Secretariat documents. The new guidance issued is not the administrative instruction referred to in the recommendation. Therefore, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
